signals.title: Europese Commissie wil MiCA uitbreiden voor tokenisering en niet-EU stablecoin-emittenten
signals.summary: The European Commission is reportedly seeking comment from stakeholders on expanding MiCA rules until Sept. 30.

signals.title: Tokenisering en stablecoins mogelijk minder risico bij Democratische zetel ondanks onzekere regelgeving
signals.summary: Tokenization and stablecoins may weather Democrats' sweep as broader crypto rules face uncertainty

signals.title: ECB en EU centrale banken willen MiCA-depositorequirements voor stablecoins aanpassen
signals.summary: The ECB and EU central banks want to replace MiCA’s stablecoin bank-deposit requirements with liquidity thresholds, warning that sudden withdrawals could strain lenders.

signals.title: EBA publiceert ontwerpmethodologie voor boeterollen onder MiCA
signals.summary: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) published today a Consultation Paper with a draft methodology for setting fines in its role as supervisor under MiCA. The objective is to ensure that fines imposed on issuers of significant crypto-assets are consistent, proportionate and transparent, and effectively support compliance with the regulatory framework.

signals.title: Amundi tokeniseert aandelenindexfonds op Ethereum
signals.summary: The new share class offers blockchain-based exposure to an index tracking 600 companies across European markets.

signals.title: Nigeria voert licentievereisten in en verbiedt algoritmische stablecoins
signals.summary: Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services.

signals.title: EBA stelt vereenvoudigde regelgeving voor toezichtsrapportage met langere implementatietermijnen voor
signals.summary: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today outlines the way forward for the finalisation of proposals to simplify EU supervisory reporting, following extensive dialogue with the banking industry and feedback received during the public consultation. The package that is currently being finalised will introduce additional simplification measures, greater proportionality and extended implementation timelines, reducing reporting costs while preserving the information necessary for effective supervision. The final report on the draft Implementing Technical Standards (ITS) on supervisory reporting will be published by the EBA in December 2026.

signals.title: Nigeriaanse centrale bank voert vergunningseisen stablecoins in, verbiedt algoritmische varianten
signals.summary: Nigeria's central bank issued new virtual asset regulations requiring stablecoin issuers and other service providers to obtain local licenses.
